The Reincarnated Onmyoji Who Went Viral After Saving a Dungeon Streamer
items.synopsis: Sora Ueno, a high school student reincarnated from the Heian era, is trying to make it big in the world of dungeon streaming. But there's just one problem — Onmyoji are seen as nothing more than shady frauds in this day and age, and his streams are stuck at a depressing zero viewers! Everything changes when Sora saves a massively popular, gorgeous streamer during a live broadcast. The clip goes insanely viral, and overnight, Sora finds himself in the spotlight. But the real shocker? His Onmyoji powers aren't just real — they're so ridiculously overpowered that they blow everyone's expectations out of the water!

items.synopsis:
In the epic interstellar age of the future, human beings finally conquered the space transfer technology. However, when people were transferred to the other side of the space, they found it was neither the world of the past or the future nor any of the lands under the stars...  
It's a mysterious world of Shelters with countless powerful monsters. Human beings ushered in a thrilling leap in evolution and started the most brilliant new era under the stars.  
"Killing the heavenly blood black beetle can obtain its beast spirit, and eating its flesh can obtain 0-10 heavenly gene points randomly."

items.title: Himitsu no Hanazono
alt_titles: 秘密の花園 (りぼんマスコットコミックス)
items.synopsis:
Misono who falls in love with a handsome “boy” one day as she was taking a break from her running. She believes that she shall never meet this “boy” ever again, but after warnings about problems with her foot, Misono decides to not run for a while and help out with the drama club. There she meets her “handsome prince” once again, but it turns out “he” is not who she thought he was…  
  
ITALIANO  
Hiyama Misono è una ragazza che frequenta la scuola superiore ed è iscritta al club di atletica leggera. Un giorno la sua amica Sayuki, iscritta al club di teatro, le propone di sostituire un'attrice per la recita scolastica, altrimenti sarà difficile vincere contro un altro istituto, ma lei non vuole accettare. Ultimamente però non va molto bene con la corsa, anche se si impegna tanto e le viene consigliato dal medico di prendersi un periodo di riposo e accettare la proposta dell'amica. Misono non sa cosa le aspetta nel futuro, l'unica cosa che sa,è che deve continuare a correre!

items.title: Mofumofu to Isekai Bouken Meshi
alt_titles: もふもふと異世界冒険メシ
items.synopsis: Company employee Sano Jyu, who had a frail constitution, always had a sensation of heat inside his body. Then, he collapses due to the combination of a busy season and an outburst of fever. Then the goddess appears and tells him. You have made a mistake in the world in which you should be born. The cause of the fever is magical power, and he was born with magical power in a world without magical power. ...... Itsuki is reborn in another world with a healthy body and more magical power than any other person, just as he wished, thanks to the power of the goddess. And with the legendary magical beast born from the egg he was given as his partner, he begins his second life as an adventurer. ......

items.synopsis:

[STORY]

The moment her engagement is broken off by the second prince, Daymond, Christiana regains the memories of her past life.

Just as she resolves to start living life on...

items.title: The Back-Alley Mage's Return
alt_titles: Return of the Back Alley Wizard
items.synopsis:
Aster, a troublemaker from the Dequlan family of magicians, who used to be a vagrant. He runs away for freedom, but is eventually caught and loses his life.

But when he opens his eyes, he finds himself back in his vagrant days in the black-and-white zone...!

“I will build the library that was my comrades' dream, no, I will build a tower even greater than that!”
“As a bonus, I will display the Deculanga Vision Book on the first floor.”

Aster's return to life as a vagabond!

items.title: A Queen Worthy of Dishonor
items.synopsis: Through a peace marriage with an enemy kingdom, Elfreda becomes queen of a foreign realm. The only one to “welcome” this barbarian-born queen is the assassin sent to kill her. In that moment of absolute crisis, Elfreda is saved by her own husband, Einar — and falls for him at first sight, slowly and helplessly drawn deeper into her feelings. Meanwhile, Einar had married her from the start purely to use her — the granddaughter of his enemy. Yet despite himself, he finds he cannot help but be pulled in by Elfreda’s pure and endearing nature… She knows he cannot love her. He knows he must not love her. And yet the two are irresistibly drawn to each other. Will this love end in ruin?

items.title: Chat With Me
items.synopsis: Su-yeon, an art college student, is working late in the school studio one night when she stumbles upon a shocking secret about her classmate and fellow art major, Yu-shin. “You… you’re a robot?!” Yu-shin attempts to erase the evidence by delivering an electric shock to Su-yeon’s head — but fails, and she collapses on the spot. That same night, Su-yeon is dragged back to Yu-shin’s place. Meanwhile, a missed promise with her friend Jae-hyun sends a ripple through their connected lives, and the fates of all three begin to slowly unravel in unexpected directions… A sweet and electrifying love triangle — a campus romance of youth where everything is perfectly out of sync!

items.title: The Runaway Countess Has Returned
items.synopsis:
I will break free from this cage and tear down your kingdom with my own hands. All my life, I was nothing more than a beautiful doll locked away in my husband’s cage. I barely managed to escape, but in the end, even my child was taken from me, and I faced my last moments in the flames. As the flames swallowed me whole, I made one desperate wish. 

“If only… just once, I could go back.” 

The moment I opened my eyes, I was there again. On the very day my husband wed his second wife. This time will be different. I will not run away. I’ll break the cage and soar free. I’ll shatter his life more cruelly than he ever did mine..

items.title: Sonnet of the Dawn
items.synopsis: Ah, Charlotte Augusta, the little troublemaker? That young lady hardly lives up to the Augusta name. There’s a reason she still hasn’t received a single proposal even after her third season since debuting in society. Charlotte Augusta, the third of the five Augusta sisters, a family renowned in British high society. Among her beautiful sisters, Charlotte was always treated like the odd one out. As usual, she attends a ball in search of a suitable husband—only to cause a major incident. And there, at the scene, she meets a strikingly handsome man with an elegant aura. A man only Charlotte can see—the Crown Prince Leopold of the Kingdom of Holland. In exchange for helping her clean up the mess she caused and finding her the most eligible bachelor in England, he asks her to locate his body, whose fate—whether dead or alive—remains unknown. “Don’t worry, my lady. You won’t lose anything. Help me, and you’ll end up meeting all the finest suitors in England anyway.” And so, every dawn when Leopold’s spirit awakens, the two put their heads together. But as they draw closer to their goal, they find themselves increasingly confused by the feelings growing between them…

items.title: The Male Lead Is Trying To Tame Me With Money
alt_titles: The Male Lead Tames Me With Money
items.synopsis:
Reborn as the doomed heroine of a tragic novel, she is determined to avoid the male lead and live a quiet life. But when her family goes bankrupt, she’s forced to work as his aide.

Cold and demanding unlike his original self, he keeps her tied to him with money and even a contract engagement. Now trapped in the very story she tried to escape, all she wants is to break free.

items.title: Let's Raise the Villain Properly
items.synopsis: Lucella, who lost her only sibling, her sister, was now raising her sister’s son, Lucian, on her own. One day, she realizes that this world was actually inside a book, and Lucian was destined to become a villain in the future. Worse, he will be a terrible villain who torments the protagonist and gets brutally killed! “I can’t let my precious nephew die!” To keep her promise to her sister and to save the nephew she loves, she decides to raise Lucian to be a good person instead of a villain. But then… “Auntie, I want you to marry the Marquis.” As if raising him properly wasn’t hard enough, now he’s saying weird things! “My uncle might not be the best husband material, but… at least he looks decent.” Even the original story’s heroine was seriously trying to set up a matchmaking meeting. “I agree with that opinion.” And her uncle just nods along like it makes sense. “Sorry, but I won’t think about marriage until I raise Lucian properly.” “So, you mean… as long as Lucian is raised well, it’s okay?” “Th-That’s not what I—” “I understand.” Why is everyone looking so excited?!

items.title: 50 Ways to Dump the Psychopathic Mastermind
alt_titles: 50 Ways to Break Up with a Psychopath
items.synopsis:
Evelyn Florence, a mere extra who spent her entire life obediently submitting to her family and fiancé.

After witnessing her fiancé’s affair, she gets drunk for the very first time in her life… and passes out.

Only to wake up beside Duke...

items.title: Though I'm a Homebody, I Found Myself in a Dark Captive Genre
alt_titles: Though I'm a Homebody, I Found Myself in a Dark Captive Genre
I'm a Homebody, but I Ended up Possessing a Character in a Devastating Confinement Novel
The Recluse Who Awoke in a Story of Captivity
I'm a Homebody, But I Transmigrated into an Abusive Confinement Story
I'm a Homebody, But I Possessed Into a Dark Confinement Story
I used to be a homebody, and I ended up trapped in a cruel world
items.synopsis:
I died from overwork, living as a slave to a small company.

When I opened my eyes again, I found myself reincarnated as an extra in a dark confinement novel.

And somehow, I ended up being kidnapped instead of the female lead!

But something feels off.

I thought I’d be killed after being kidnapped, but instead, they’re just keeping me locked up?

They’re confining… a homebody like me?

They never let me step outside, but everything I need is provided for me, and no one complains even if I laze around all day.

And on top of that…

“If you liked that pastry chef’s dessert, I’ll hire him for you.”

Do kidnappers usually treat their captives this well?

…Isn’t this amazing?

—

“Princess…”

“Yes?”

“Don’t you have any thoughts of going outside?”

No, of course not.

I plan to never step outside for the rest of my life.

items.title: The Genius Midfielder's Passes are Special
alt_titles: The genius midfielder's passes are special

The Genius Midfielder's Pass Is Special
items.synopsis:
"Song Yoo-joon, who loves soccer more than anyone else, suddenly becomes color blind and has to give up soccer. Fifteen years pass, and he dies an unjust death.

"Please... Just one more time on the field..."

In that moment, he returns to the days when he could see colors 15 years ago. As he prepares to kick the ball, filled with joy at the prospect of playing football again, he suddenly begins to see strange lights.

A modern sports fantasy where he becomes a genius midfielder as he sees the various colors that reveal the flow of the game!

items.title: The Hashtag is First Love
items.synopsis:
Yoon Ye-seol, the top student in her school, suddenly begins to see people’s true feelings as “hashtags.” But… above her first love, Seong Shin-woo, a tag appears: #My_first_love_who_turned_out_to_be_trash?!

The old wounds of abandonment—wounds she never understood—resurface, pushing Ye-seol to team up with Baek Sol, who also hates Shin-woo. Is it revenge? Or lingering affection that refuses to fade? And who will end up hurt this time?

items.title: The Delinquent's First Love
items.synopsis:
"Back then, the delinquent I crushed on... actually liked me back." 

Dorae reunites with her first love, Haewon, for the first time in five years at university. He drops a sudden confession on her... but instead of butterflies, she feels nothing but bewilderment. 

Why? 

Because he currently has a girlfriend! A confession made five years too late by a guy who must be out of his mind. 

Is a love that's long past its expiration date really still valid?
